subject: dplyr: using function parameters with dplyr

messages.author: 33730d0de61ed699
messages.subject: dplyr: using function parameters with dplyr
parts:
Hi,

is there a way (well it is R, more like: I don't know how) to get filter rules from a function parameter?

E.g.

function(param=variable==TRUE)
{
tbl(sb_monitor,"device") %>%
 filter(???)
}

What would I put in filter(???), to get the same as

tbl(sb_monitor,"device") %>%
 filter(variable==TRUE)

on the command line? Substitute&friends get you something that looks OK but isn't accepted by %>%. 
I didn't try it with %.% because according to this list it seems to be on its way out. :)

Thanks a lot.
Stefan

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: dplyr: using function parameters with dplyr
parts:
In this case you can just do

f <- function(...) tbl(sb_monitor, "device") %>% filter(...)

See http://stackoverflow.com/a/23001142/16632 for more details.

Hadley
